description:
Create a new SQLite reporting database named 'ChinookReports' in DBeaver. 

1. Create a new SQLite connection named 'ChinookReports' pointing to /home/ga/Documents/databases/chinook_reports.db (DBeaver will create the file).
2. Populate this new database with data derived from the source Chinook database (/home/ga/Documents/databases/chinook.db). You may attach the source database or query it via a separate connection.

Create and populate these three tables in chinook_reports.db:

- 'artist_summary': One row per artist (including those with 0 albums). Columns: ArtistId, ArtistName, AlbumCount, TrackCount, TotalDurationMinutes, AvgTrackDurationSeconds.

- 'genre_revenue': One row per genre (only those with revenue > 0). Columns: GenreId, GenreName, TrackCount, TotalRevenue, AvgTrackPrice, UniqueCustomers. Sort by TotalRevenue descending.

- 'monthly_sales': One row per month. Columns: YearMonth (format 'YYYY-MM'), InvoiceCount, TotalRevenue, UniqueCustomers, AvgInvoiceTotal. Sort by YearMonth ascending.

3. Save your SQL work as a script to /home/ga/Documents/scripts/create_reports_db.sql.
